text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After Biwa Hayahide wins at Hanshin Racecourse, the two of us head to a hair salon rumored to be incredible.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: So this is the place City was talking about…

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: There's this salon that's super popular right now. Their slogan is, "A brand new you, starting with your scalp." It's supposed to be amazing.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Scalp cleansing changes your hair at a fundamental level, they say! Oh… Whoops. It looks like they moved. Out west, to Kansai…

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I was shocked when I heard they had moved to Kansai, but these legs of mine, which carried me to victory, have also carried me here…

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: The moment has come—I shall now say goodbye to my unruly hair. Wait for me here.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I wait for her impatiently, excited to see what she'll look like after her makeover.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Sorry to have kept you waiting, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: When I turn around, I'm pulled into a world of magical fantasy with Biwa Hayahide at its center. It looks as if she has a halo over her…

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hehe. So what do you think?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I knew you'd be able to tell how much my hair quality has improved! It's been tamed on an atomic level!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: That was an extraordinary head spa treatment. My hair rejoiced with each new pressure point they massaged on my scalp!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Their database utilizes the latest AI technology, and they used it to create a custom treatment plan for me! I have the hair of a goddess now!
choice_data_list: Sounds like you had a good time in there!
Sounds like you had a good time in there!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Oh, indeed! Words cannot describe just how thrilled I am. The whole experience felt akin to victory in a race.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I'm going to go and get some fresh air!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She looks like a delighted child as she prances off, but after only a few steps…

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Wh-what in the world?! Trainer, something's wrong! My body doesn't feel right!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: My joints are so stiff it's as if they're rusted over! And all I did was break into a light jog!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Oh no… This must be because of my hair! It's become so silky smooth that my mind and body are out of sync with its reduced air resistance!
choice_data_list: I guess you'll have to let your hair go back to the way it was before…

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: What?! But then I'll have to contend once more with the unwieldy mess that vexed me for so many years!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I must construct a plan to resolve this issue. I can still figure something out before my next race—it'll just take some all-nighters…
Waaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We notice someone crying a short distance away. It's a racer that Biwa Hayahide competed against earlier today. She's shoving takoyaki into her tear-stained cheeks.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Hic! I-I won't lose next time! Just you wait, Biwa Hayahide!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: …They told me my hair will go back to the way it was if I skip a single day of treatment, so I bought a bulk supply of their product.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Could you hold on to it all for me?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I don't. With so many rivals, I have neither the time nor the luxury to be fussing over my hair.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: You can give it all back to me once I feel like I've finally made it.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Keep those products safe for me until then, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Biwa Hayahide smiles, and her cheerful expression glows as brilliantly as the setting sun!
